additional_info.subject: RE: ID0420056-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002550] authentication not possible via RFID card. CRM:02698000054
additional_info.body:
Dear Benjamin Perske,
We have reviewed the logs of the reported time and found that the ID tag "{:"040048AACA1491"} did not authenticate. However, shortly afterward, two to three other RFID tags were successfully authenticated on the same reader. This indicates that the RFID reader is functioning correctly.
Could you please try charging using a different RFID tag?
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
